# Quarterly

> Quarterly (Q Creative Limited) is a design subscription studio. Marketing and creative teams get a dedicated in-house designer, backed by a creative lead, on a monthly subscription. Plans start at £1,266 ($2,000) a month for 40 hours of design on a quarterly plan, or £1,599 ($2,499) a month rolling.

Quarterly has 21 designers based in the UK and South Africa. They are employed by Quarterly, not freelancers. Each client works with the same assigned designer every day, and a creative lead reviews the work. Clients send briefs through Brief, Quarterly's client portal. The first proof arrives within 24 hours, or the same day if the brief arrives before midday.

Most clients are B2B scale-ups with 50 to 200 staff, often in SaaS and fintech, and usually buy through a head of marketing. Larger organisations (500 to 2,000+ staff) also use Quarterly to support a single marketing, brand or creative team.

## How it works

- Pick a plan and a monthly number of hours: 40, 60, 80 or 100.
- Onboarding can happen within 24 hours. On the onboarding call you meet your creative lead and assigned designer, get set up on Brief and go through your first project.
- You can scale up within 24 hours.
- Unused hours roll over to the next month, capped at two months' worth.
- You can pause or cancel with 7 days' notice, or 30 days' notice on 80+ hours a month or on a quarterly plan.

## Plans and pricing

The Professional plan covers static design: branding, social, digital and web, print and exhibitions, presentations and pitch decks, eBooks, icons and illustration. The Dynamic plan includes everything in Professional plus video editing, animation and motion design.

Monthly prices (UK prices exclude VAT):

- Professional, quarterly plan: 40h £1,266 ($2,000) · 60h £1,900 ($2,966) · 80h £2,533 ($3,933) · 100h £3,166 ($4,800)
- Professional, 30-day rolling: 40h £1,599 ($2,499) · 60h £2,399 ($3,699) · 80h £3,199 ($4,899) · 100h £3,999 ($5,999)
- Dynamic, quarterly plan: 40h £1,600 ($2,566) · 60h £2,400 ($3,766) · 80h £3,200 ($4,966) · 100h £4,000 ($6,000)
- Dynamic, 30-day rolling: 40h £1,999 ($3,199) · 60h £2,999 ($4,699) · 80h £3,999 ($6,199) · 100h £4,999 ($7,499)

Quarterly plans are billed every three months. Rolling plans are billed monthly.
